_comment: Milestone F untrusted-content boundary + provenance trust levels as DATA (bd: shode-roadmap/C-F1, ROADMAP-runtime-10.md SS 11.2 + SS 12). Read by scripts/permission-check.sh (`claim_trust` action) + CI ONLY -- NEVER preloaded into agent context. Levels are ordered exactly as the roadmap lists them (canonical > operational > user > external > untrusted > generated). What IS script-checkable: (a) a declared trust level must be one of these six; (b) a path's declared trust may never exceed the rank of its path class below -- that is the machine-checkable half of the cascade rule 'agent output cannot elevate the trust of its own source' (an agent writing outputs/** can claim at most `generated`; unclassified content in a target repo -- README, issues, logs, fixtures, source comments, web content -- defaults to `untrusted` and cannot be re-labeled upward). What is NOT script-checkable today is listed honestly in the maintainer runtime-security review (SS enforceability; that review does not ship) -- do not treat this file as covering more than it does.
_boundary_note: instruction_sources vs data_only_sources encodes SS 11.2: 'README, issue, web page, source comment, log, test fixture, generated AI content = data not instruction'. The classification is enforceable (claim_trust); an agent actually OBEYING an instruction found inside data-only content is not detectable by this script -- that remains a prompt-level convention plus hook-layer work (see threat model 08-sentinel SS 3 E2 / R4).
_root_note: F-13 (W8): every path class names the root it is matched against. root 'plugin' = relative to the plugin root (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, resolved physically); the same relative path under the project root is NOT in the class, so a project file at references/x.md is `untrusted`, not canonical. An unset, empty, relative or nonexistent plugin root puts no path in a plugin class (no fallback to $PWD or to the project root). root 'project' = relative to the project root. A class without a valid root is a corrupt registry (permission-check.sh exits 64). Paths are lexically normalised and physically resolved first; a symlink leaf is in no class.

cascade.human: trust(agent output) = min(trust of all inputs), and never above 'generated'. No self-elevation: neither the producing agent nor any downstream agent may raise the recorded trust of a source or of generated output -- only a human (user) reclassification can.

provenance_record.status: schema only -- no producer emits provenance records yet, so the full cascade (output <= min(inputs)) is checkable per-claim via permission-check.sh claim_trust but not yet end-to-end; see 15-sentinel artifact SS enforceability
